#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Read the pushed refs
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(basename "$refname")

    case "$branch" in
        main)
            deploy_dir="/var/www/main"
            ;;
        dev)
            deploy_dir="/var/www/dev"
            ;;
        *)
            continue
            ;;
    esac

    # Create temporary directory for deployment
    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    trap "rm -rf $temp_dir" EXIT

    # Clone the branch to temporary directory
    git --work-tree="$temp_dir" checkout -f "$branch"

    # Clear deployment directory and copy new content
    rm -rf "$deploy_dir"/*
    cp -r "$temp_dir"/* "$deploy_dir/" 2>/dev/null || true

    # Ensure proper permissions
    chmod -R 755 "$deploy_dir"
done

rm -rf /git/project/*

rm -rf /var/www/dev/*

# Reinitialize the git repository
cd /git/project

# Make hook again
cat > /git/project/hooks/post-receive << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(basename "$refname")

    case "$branch" in
        main)
            deploy_dir="/var/www/main"
            ;;
        dev)
            deploy_dir="/var/www/dev"
            ;;
        *)
            continue
            ;;
    esac

    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    trap "rm -rf $temp_dir" EXIT

    git --work-tree="$temp_dir" checkout -f "$branch"

    rm -rf "$deploy_dir"/*
    cp -r "$temp_dir"/* "$deploy_dir/" 2>/dev/null || true

    chmod -R 755 "$deploy_dir"
